description: `ServerType.capabilities` carries three members the document omits: `placement_groups` (boolean), `hot_snapshots_local_volume` (boolean) and `private_network` (the number of Private Networks a server of the type can join). Observed 2026-10-14: `GET /instance/v1/zones/{zone}/products/servers?per_page=100&page=1|2` in all ten Instance zones returned 756 server types; every one carried all three, none null.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Whether the Instance supports placement groups.
Whether a local volume of the Instance can be snapshotted while the Instance runs.
Maximum number of Private Networks the Instance can join.
